text: Failing this, he would pull alongside at the first opportunity and shake his fist threateningly. This negative explanation of courtesy on the freeways, however, does an injustice to Southern California drivers. At the risk of losing my charge-a-plate at Marshall Field and Company, I would like to challenge an old and hallowed stereotype. After three months of research, I can state unequivocally that Los Angeles drivers are considerably more courteous and competent than any other drivers I've ever encountered. During one recent day of driving about Los Angeles, there were actually a dozen occasions when oncoming drivers stopped an entire lane of traffic to permit me to pull out of an impossible side street.
